scenario: [LSER.10.9] / [LSER.16.9] / [LSER.14.1]: `direction all_time` compares the two newest samples ever absorbed for the identity and answers `+1`, `0` or `-1`, `null` with fewer than two; on `all_time` it rides the running-stats backing (SeriesBackendWelfordEwma, [LSER.18.1]), where the two newest absorbed samples are the two newest in the series, rather than the ring buffer a sliding `direction` reads. Values 1, 3, 2, 4 then 5, one per pump, each read pre-sample ([LSER.8.6.1]): cold and one-sample reads are `null` (no log); [1, 3] -> 1; [1, 3, 2] -> -1; [1, 3, 2, 4] -> 1. Drives libds `welford_ewma.c`'s `typed_prev` pair and the Mercury `ds.series` `agg_direction` over the all-time samples.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    dev: String key
    level: Int mutable

series Reading.level (by: dev):
    direction all_time

rule r:
    Reading s where s.direction is not null
->
    log info "direction {s.direction}"
